name: Ecomail
description: Provides API integration with Ecomail marketing platform.
project_description: Ecomail provides a low-level API integration between Drupal and the Ecomail (ecomail.cz) email-marketing platform. It ships a single service, ecomail.client, that wraps the ecomailcz/ecomail PHP SDK and exposes the Ecomail REST API v2 (lists, subscribers, campaigns, automations, templates, domains, transactional emails, transactions, product/data feeds, events, contact search and discount coupons). The API key is stored as a Key entity via the Key module and selected on a small settings form. The module provides no user-facing subscribe forms, blocks, fields or hooks of its own; it is a building block meant to be consumed by other custom or contrib modules.
